### BHTF — your-turn placeholder replaced
The template "Take what you learned from [X] and apply it to your own work. What's one thing you'll try first?" is one of 3,472 seeded placeholders. Authored a real, scaffolded exercise from this reel's own content:

> Open your longest current Claude session. Read the transcript top-to-bottom and label every block: still shaping the next output, or dead weight. If nothing is still doing work, run /clear. If any single issue has been corrected more than twice, rewrite the spec into CLAUDE.md and /clear. Report which choice the transcript earned.

Narration authored to speak the exercise.
